calendar.limitation: Bounded SSE/SZSE calendar; no assumptions outside its horizon or about emergency closures.

run.cost_description: Buy 8bp / sell 13bp includes 3bp commission + 5bp slippage proxy, sell adds 5bp stamp duty; minimum CNY5. Research assumptions, not a broker quote. No separate nonlinear impact model.
limitations: Current liquidity universe selected after the historical test; survivorship and screening bias
Post hoc historical out-of-sample evaluation, not preregistered or forward unseen evidence
Historical ST and exact daily limits unverified: conservative directional 4.5% adjusted-open gap blocks
STAR buys excluded because the baseline uses 100-share lots
Missing daily quotes are non-tradable, not a certified suspension-reason table
Vendor effective-date HFQ factors not independently reconciled to corporate actions
Daily open-price fills and previous-session 1% volume cap are approximations, not auction replay
Historical ST/limit-price and halt reason not independently certified
Historical vendor revisions not point-in-time snapshots
Vendor HFQ multipliers not independently reconciled to corporate-action ledger
run.selection_bias: current liquidity universe; survivorship and pre-screen bias; non-PIT
